Chapter 6498: I Have A Treasure

Chapter 6498: I Have A Treasure

Two giants appeared, large enough to fill the whole dream world. However, the crowd no longer viewed Li Qiye as an underdog despite the difference in size.

The powers couldn’t suppress him as he stood still, seemingly the center of everything. Both the real and the dream world circled him and were bent to his will.

“You may have all of Paragon’s power.” The Lord of Paragon shouted.

“Yes, and the everlasting life force.” The longevity spirit did the same.

Many became confused because these two lords were sealed in the source earlier as puppets. How did they maintain control over the dream realms?

The powers became purer when these lords were active. The primal ancestors thought the amount coming from the divine chains was only sixty or seventy percent at best. They wondered about the sudden change of heart when the enemy was Li Qiye.

Did these two lords have grievances toward Li Qiye? Either way, they couldn’t refuse the influx of power since they needed it right now.

Li Qiye slightly frowned upon seeing this but didn’t say anything.

“Got a plan?” Trinity asked. They knew they would lose but the man no longer wanted to spare them. The only way out was a fight to the death.

Seventy-two despised Li Qiye for bringing up his trauma and now believed the man was the cause behind it all.

“I have a treasure.” His eyes gleamed with cruelty and determination.

“What?” Trinity became curious.

“Left behind by Senior Poye, the ancient flame of a true immortal. Not much is left but it should be enough to burn an immortal.” Seventy-two revealed.

“No way!” Skyraiser shouted.

“Ancient flame from a true immortal?” The others became emotional.

“The flame from Nightwatch?” Nine-turns asked.

“That’s it.” Seventy-two said.

“This is going to be disastrous.” North Kun God inside Gold Village became alarmed.

“Is it real?” Whale Ancestor asked.

“It was meant to burn the great tree, right?” Stoneboiler became afraid.

“It’s real.” North Kun said.

No one doubted his word since he was a direct disciple of Desolate Ancestor. Nightwatch was one of the three great immortal wars.

It involved not only Poye and Desolate Ancestor but also other overlords from Life and Death Heaven and Supreme Heaven.

Few knew why the war started. Perhaps it was unavoidable due to the unending feud between the two immortals.

However, the participants knew differently - Poye found an ancient flame, perhaps left behind by his master.

After finding it, he wanted to burn a supreme tree. This tree had never been seen before but was rumored to come from the primordial.

Cultivation, dao power, dao laws, and all else came from this tree. Poye wanted to torch it to start a new cultivation system.

However, Desolate Ancestor came to stop this because her cultivation system also came from this tree. This started Nightwatch War, rumored to have ended with her defeat.

“Burn an immortal...” The primal ancestors had seen Poye before and became interested.

“We mustn’t, it’ll be a disaster.” Skyraiser disagreed.

“What else can we do?! Do you all just want to sit and wait for death instead of going all out?!” Seventy-two raised his voice.
